name: a split dashboard reconciles note and invoice live
looks: A dashboard panel holds the field note on one side and a running list of invoice line items on the other. Each line item highlights together with the exact phrase in the note that justifies it, one pair at a time, and a corrected total rolls up at the bottom as the pairs confirm.
build: The panel is a fixed DOM split-pane (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic); each note phrase and its matching line item highlight within one beat of each other (text-diff-highlight); the total's digits roll up the instant each pair confirms.
sound: A soft highlighter tick per matched pair and a light chime as the total updates.
prompt: Hold a split dashboard panel with a field note on one side and a running invoice on the other, highlighting one matched pair at a time, the phrase that justifies a charge and the charge itself, with a corrected total rolling up at the bottom as each pair confirms.
